channel.title: 研究生英语学术词汇
channel.description: 基于艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线的学术词汇词库

item.title: hypothesis
item.description: /haɪˈpɒθəsɪs/|n.|假设；假说|The data support our original hypothesis.

item.title: empirical
item.description: /ɪmˈpɪrɪkl/|adj.|经验的；实证的|The theory lacks empirical evidence.

item.title: paradigm
item.description: /ˈpærədaɪm/|n.|范式；典范|This discovery shifted the scientific paradigm.

item.title: methodology
item.description: /ˌmeθəˈdɒlədʒi/|n.|方法论；研究方法|We must clarify the research methodology first.

item.title: correlation
item.description: /ˌkɒrəˈleɪʃn/|n.|相关性；关联|There is a strong correlation between the two variables.

item.title: comprehensive
item.description: /ˌkɒmprɪˈhensɪv/|adj.|全面的；综合的|The report offers a comprehensive analysis.

item.title: ambiguous
item.description: /æmˈbɪɡjuəs/|adj.|模糊的；有歧义的|His answer was deliberately ambiguous.

item.title: facilitate
item.description: /fəˈsɪlɪteɪt/|v.|促进；使便利|Technology facilitates collaborative learning.

item.title: undermine
item.description: /ˌʌndəˈmaɪn/|v.|削弱；动摇|Such errors could undermine public trust.

item.title: coherent
item.description: /kəʊˈhɪərənt/|adj.|连贯的；有条理的|Your essay needs a more coherent structure.

item.title: preliminary
item.description: /prɪˈlɪmɪnəri/|adj.|初步的；预备的|These are only preliminary findings.

item.title: significant
item.description: /sɪɡˈnɪfɪkənt/|adj.|显著的；重要的|The results show a significant difference.

item.title: arbitrary
item.description: /ˈɑːbɪtrəri/|adj.|任意的；武断的|The choice of sample size seems arbitrary.

item.title: explicit
item.description: /ɪkˈsplɪsɪt/|adj.|明确的；清晰的|The instructions should be explicit.

item.title: implicit
item.description: /ɪmˈplɪsɪt/|adj.|含蓄的；隐含的|There is an implicit assumption here.

item.title: inherent
item.description: /ɪnˈhɪərənt/|adj.|固有的；内在的|Risk is inherent in any investment.

item.title: intrinsic
item.description: /ɪnˈtrɪnsɪk/|adj.|本质的；内在的|Curiosity has intrinsic value.

item.title: plausible
item.description: /ˈplɔːzəbl/|adj.|似乎合理的|That sounds like a plausible explanation.

item.title: prevalent
item.description: /ˈprevələnt/|adj.|普遍的；流行的|The disease is prevalent in rural areas.

item.title: subsequent
item.description: /ˈsʌbsɪkwənt/|adj.|随后的；后来的|Subsequent studies confirmed the result.

item.title: substantial
item.description: /səbˈstænʃl/|adj.|大量的；实质的|There is substantial evidence for this claim.

item.title: valid
item.description: /ˈvælɪd/|adj.|有效的；正当的|The argument is logically valid.

item.title: relevant
item.description: /ˈreləvənt/|adj.|相关的；切题的|Please cite relevant literature.

item.title: derive
item.description: /dɪˈraɪv/|v.|得到；源于|The word derives from Latin.

item.title: imply
item.description: /ɪmˈplaɪ/|v.|暗示；意味着|His silence implies agreement.

item.title: infer
item.description: /ɪnˈfɜː(r)/|v.|推断；推论|We can infer the cause from the data.

item.title: constitute
item.description: /ˈkɒnstɪtjuːt/|v.|构成；组成|Women constitute half of the workforce.

item.title: attribute
item.description: /əˈtrɪbjuːt/|v.|归因于|He attributes his success to hard work.

item.title: assess
item.description: /əˈses/|v.|评估；评定|We need to assess the risks carefully.

item.title: comprise
item.description: /kəmˈpraɪz/|v.|包含；由……组成|The committee comprises ten members.

item.title: contradict
item.description: /ˌkɒntrəˈdɪkt/|v.|反驳；与……矛盾|The findings contradict earlier reports.

item.title: demonstrate
item.description: /ˈdemənstreɪt/|v.|证明；演示|The experiment demonstrates the principle.

item.title: distinguish
item.description: /dɪˈstɪŋɡwɪʃ/|v.|区分；辨别|We must distinguish fact from opinion.

item.title: eliminate
item.description: /ɪˈlɪmɪneɪt/|v.|消除；排除|We should eliminate all possible errors.

item.title: emphasize
item.description: /ˈemfəsaɪz/|v.|强调；着重|The author emphasizes the need for reform.

item.title: evaluate
item.description: /ɪˈvæljueɪt/|v.|评价；评估|It is hard to evaluate the long-term impact.

item.title: illustrate
item.description: /ˈɪləstreɪt/|v.|说明；举例说明|The chart illustrates the trend clearly.

item.title: indicate
item.description: /ˈɪndɪkeɪt/|v.|表明；指出|The results indicate a clear pattern.

item.title: integrate
item.description: /ˈɪntɪɡreɪt/|v.|整合；融入|We should integrate theory with practice.

item.title: justify
item.description: /ˈdʒʌstɪfaɪ/|v.|证明……正当|Nothing can justify such behaviour.

item.title: paradigm
item.description: /ˈpærədaɪm/|n.|范式；典范|The discovery marked a paradigm shift in the field of physics.

item.title: skeptical
item.description: /ˈskeptɪkl/|adj.|怀疑的；持怀疑态度的|Researchers should remain skeptical of results that cannot be replicated.

item.title: hypothesis
item.description: /haɪˈpɒθəsɪs/|n.|假设；假说|The study aims to test the hypothesis that sleep deprivation affects cognitive performance.

item.title: empirical
item.description: /ɪmˈpɪrɪkl/|adj.|经验的；实证的|There is no empirical evidence to support his thesis.

item.title: methodology
item.description: /ˌmeθəˈdɒlədʒi/|n.|方法论；方法学|The paper outlined a rigorous methodology for sampling water quality.
